limitations: Install project dependencies from uv.lock, requirements files, or the project manifest.
Compatibility with a particular project must include its dependencies, not only requires-python.

changes: Use system certificates for uv when LIBRARY_CA_FILE supplies a private CA, while preserving explicit uv and OpenSSL trust settings.
3.14-trixie.migration: Compatible trust fix. Supply CA_CERTIFICATE through the public runners for intercepted HTTPS; explicit UV_SYSTEM_CERTS, UV_NATIVE_TLS, SSL_CERT_FILE and SSL_CERT_DIR settings retain precedence. Validate the new digest in the consuming project before upgrading.

purpose: Python development with uv, pip, venv, native compilation and PostgreSQL clients.
